ruleDefinitions.name: PUA - Netcat Suspicious Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of Netcat. Adversaries may use a non-application layer protocol for communication between host and C2 server or among infected hosts within a network

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\nc\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\ncat\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\netcat\\\.exe$")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-lvp\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-lvnp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-l\\ \\-v\\ \\-p\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-lv\\ \\-p\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-l\\ \\-\\-proxy\\-type\\ http\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-vnl\\ \\-\\-exec\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-vnl\\ \\-e\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-lua\\-exec\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-sh\\-exec\\ .*")))
